### Questions for the table

- Which block gives this child his first identifier in your country: birth registration, the national ID, or the health client registry? Exists, partial or absent? ([J2b](en/smart-trust-demo/journeys/smart-trust-demo/workshops/dpi-h-policy-track/walkthrough/J2b/))
- When a birth happened abroad and is not registered at home, how does the child enter your registries — and your coverage denominator? ([J2b](en/smart-trust-demo/journeys/smart-trust-demo/workshops/dpi-h-policy-track/walkthrough/J2b/))
